critique.hierarchy: A emphasizes the attendance deadline; B exposes more next-class content; selection leads with criteria; intake leads with step context.
critique.typography: Vietnamese headings readable, strong contrast. Small metadata remains secondary; critical actions carry text labels.
critique.spacing: 24px product gutter. No observed clipping; long forms and lists scroll behind floating tabs with bottom reserve.
critique.media: No raster media, no crop claims. Initials are synthetic identifiers; icons support words.
critique.distinctiveness: Rounded grayscale task objects, circular directional control and capsule navigation transfer the requested reference grammar without course-screen copying.
